answer: Resist sybils with a wandering attestation passport. First, a newcomer registers once and must wander through five independent regional juries over 30 days, earning a signed stamp from each. Second, every jury sets a fresh live task in its own region, from timber counts to tundra sensor readings, so one script cannot pass everywhere. Third, a failed stamp resets the journey and a forgery burns a 150-token bond. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 1,500,000 tokens and needs 50,000 live checks in 30 days. Like a traveller earning trust town by town, only a real agent finishes the road.
